headline: Microsoft launches Surface Laptop Ultra with Nvidia RTX Spark
summary: Microsoft unveiled the Surface Laptop Ultra, powered by Nvidia's RTX Spark chip, at a San Francisco Windows and Surface event. It starts at $2,599, launches October 16, and ships with a magnetic USB-C charging cable and new Windows 11 features; outlets differ slightly on the base configuration's CPU core count.
